findings: Database builder installs the reviewed 1->2 and 2->3 migrations with no destructive-fallback option. Schema files and actual Room validation still need qualification; no database upgrade executed.

String-list converter joins with unescaped |||---|||. An element containing that sequence becomes multiple entries on read; empty list and single empty-string list both encode as empty string and decode to empty list. Source-only serialization noninjectivity.
UnreadableFileCache stores only path, lastModified and size, with no error class, retry time or decode/recipe version. DAO supports upsert/get-all/clear; invalidation policy is left to callers.
FolderDetailsCache stores aggregate counts/bytes without timestamp or source identity. Freshness therefore depends on repository/event logic, still unread.
FolderDetailsDao.replaceAll is transactional clear+upsert; its query returns an unsorted Flow. No stale-order or data-loss claim without caller context.
